node.statement: Combining nodes 1.5.1 and 1.5.2 yields ||Ax||_inf>=(1-3*epsilon)||x||_inf for every x. Substituting epsilon=K*eta in this estimate and in node 1.4 gives exactly the three bounds in node 1; node 1.3 supplies commutativity, k, and iota, so the root conclusion follows.
